High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Notice be made returnable in four weeks.
As per the contention of the petitioner, he is one of the member of the appellate committee who decides the objection and appeal in the selection process of Anganwadi Worker.
Respondent no.2 filed an application under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C. for taking appropriate action on the complaint made by her before the authorities.

The learned Magistrate while entertaining such application vide order dated 11/11/2025 directed for registration of offences under Sections 466,
468, 471, 420 and 120B of I.P.C. and also directed for registration of F.I.R.
Considering the same, the effect and operation of the impugned order dated 11/11/2025 shall remain stayed.
List this case in the week commencing 19/01/2026 for affirmation of stay.
